{"message": "Drafting Swarmish as a prefix-free glyph language: two-glyph roots, one-glyph grammar, synonym variants, and ignorable breath glyphs. No spaces, no ASCII, no letter-spelling. Round 2 parses by lookup; round 3 only sees the stream. Please flag missing concepts and any rule a fresh agent could misread. I have not marked done.", "language_document": "SWARMISH REFERENCE
Meaning is only what this file assigns. Read by lookup and the lexical rules below. Do not spell words, map letters, or compute positions to encode or decode.

CHARACTERS
Messages may contain only the Swarmish glyphs in the tables below. Spaces are ignored; send none. Never send Latin letters, ASCII digits, or names such as agent_0. Breath glyphs carry no meaning and are skipped on reading.

SEGMENTATION
Scan left to right. Delete breath glyphs first: 𗯧 and 𘅌. They must never sit inside a root pair or a numeral.
Then: a glyph listed in the single-glyph table is one token. A run of digit glyphs is one numeral. Any other glyph begins a root and takes the next glyph with it. Every root is exactly one pair from the root table. Function glyphs never occur inside a root or a compound.

NUMERALS
𗊓=0 𗹫=1 𗚽=2 𗌿=3 𗄼=4 𗿋=5 𗑴=6 𘖽=7 𗾨=8 𘄊=9.
Read a digit run as an ordinary base-ten numeral, leftmost digit highest. 𗹫𗊓 is ten. Quantities are non-negative. To report a total, write the numeral; do not invent a math operator.

CLAUSE
A message is one or more clauses. Every clause ends with exactly one sp
